subject: Maths
promptText: In a right-angled triangle, the longest side is called the hypotenuse. The square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides: a2 + b2 = c2.

<svg viewBox="0 0 800 500" width="100%" height="100%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <title>Pythagoras' Theorem GCSE Maths</title>
  
  <defs>
    <!-- Background styling -->
    <radialGradient id="bgGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="70%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1e293b"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0f172a"/>
    </radialGradient>
    
    <!-- Glow filter -->
    <filter id="glow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4" result="blur" />
      <feComposite in="SourceGraphic" in2="blur" operator="over"/>
    </filter>
    
    <!-- Grid pattern -->
    <pattern id="grid" width="30" height="30" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <path d="M 30 0 L 0 0 0 30" fill="none" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="0.5" stroke-opacity="0.5"/>
    </pattern>

    <!-- Keyframe Animations -->
    <style>
      @keyframes pulseGlow {
        0% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 2px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4)); }
        50% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.8)); }
        100% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 2px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4)); }
      }
      @keyframes fadeInOut {
        0% { opacity: 0.6; }
        50% { opacity: 1; }
        100% { opacity: 0.6; }
      }
      .anim-pulse {
        animation: pulseGlow 4s infinite ease-in-out;
      }
      .math-title {
        font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
        font-weight: 700;
        fill: #f8fafc;
      }
      .math-text {
        font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
        font-weight: 600;
        fill: #cbd5e1;
      }
      .side-a { fill: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.25); stroke: #f43f5e; stroke-width: 3; }
      .side-b { fill: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.25); stroke: #3b82f6; stroke-width: 3; }
      .side-c { fill: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.25); stroke: #a855f7; stroke-width: 3; }
    </style>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background Layer -->
  <rect width="800" height="500" fill="url(#bgGrad)"/>
  <rect width="800" height="500" fill="url(#grid)"/>

  <!-- Header Section -->
  <g id="header" transform="translate(40, 40)">
    <text x="0" y="0" class="math-title" font-size="28" letter-spacing="1">Pythagoras' Theorem</text>
    <text x="0" y="24" class="math-text" font-size="14" fill="#94a3b8">For any right-angled triangle: sum of areas of smaller squares = area of largest square</text>
  </g>

  <!-- MAIN DIAGRAM GROUP (Shifted left for formula on right) -->
  <g id="triangle-diagram" transform="translate(60, 100)">
    
    <!-- Triangle Dimensions: A=(50,220), B=(230,220), C=(50,70) -->
    <!-- Base = 180 (a), Height = 150 (b), Hypotenuse = ~234.3 (c) -->

    <!-- Squares on sides -->
    <!-- Square A (bottom, 180x180 extending down) -->
    <rect x="50" y="220" width="180" height="180" class="side-a" rx="4">
      <animate attributeName="fill-opacity" values="0.2;0.4;0.2" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </rect>
    <text x="140" y="315" class="math-title" font-size="22" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fda4af">a²</text>
    <text x="140" y="335" class="math-text" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fda4af">Area = a × a</text>

    <!-- Square B (left, 150x150 extending left) -->
    <rect x="-100" y="70" width="150" height="150" class="side-b" rx="4">
      <animate attributeName="fill-opacity" values="0.2;0.4;0.2" dur="4s" begin="1.3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </rect>
    <text x="-25" y="150" class="math-title" font-size="22" text-anchor="middle" fill="#93c5fd">b²</text>
    <text x="-25" y="170" class="math-text" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle" fill="#93c5fd">Area = b × b</text>

    <!-- Square C (Hypotenuse, oriented along the slope from (50,70) to (230,220)) -->
    <!-- Length c = 234.3. Angle = atan(150/180) = 39.8 degrees -->
    <g transform="translate(50, 70) rotate(39.8)">
      <rect x="0" y="-234.3" width="234.3" height="234.3" class="side-c" rx="4" class="anim-pulse"/>
      <text x="117.15" y="-117.15" class="math-title" font-size="24" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central" fill="#d8b4fe" transform="rotate(-39.8 117.15 -117.15)">c²</text>
      <text x="117.15" y="-92.15" class="math-text" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle" fill="#d8b4fe" transform="rotate(-39.8 117.15 -92.15)">Area = c × c</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Right-angled Triangle (drawn on top of squares) -->
    <polygon points="50,70 230,220 50,220" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#f8fafc" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round" />

    <!-- Right Angle Marker -->
    <path d="M 50 195 L 75 195 L 75 220" fill="none" stroke="#f8fafc" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="62.5" cy="207.5" r="2.5" fill="#f8fafc"/>

    <!-- Triangle Side Labels -->
    <!-- Side b (height) -->
    <text x="30" y="150" class="math-title" font-size="20" fill="#3b82f6" text-anchor="middle">b</text>
    <!-- Side a (base) -->
    <text x="140" y="250" class="math-title" font-size="20" fill="#f43f5e" text-anchor="middle">a</text>
    <!-- Side c (hypotenuse) -->
    <text x="125" y="130" class="math-title" font-size="20" fill="#a855f7" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(39.8, 125, 130)">Hypotenuse (c)</text>
    
    <!-- Hypotenuse indicator tag -->
    <g transform="translate(155, 132) rotate(39.8)">
      <rect x="0" y="-12" width="75" height="20" rx="4" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#a855f7" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="37.5" y="2" class="math-text" font-size="10" fill="#d8b4fe" text-anchor="middle">Longest Side</text>
    </g>

  </g>

  <!-- RIGHT PANEL: Formula & Summary Card -->
  <g id="formula-panel" transform="translate(480, 100)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="280" height="340" rx="12" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2" filter="url(#glow)"/>
    
    <!-- Card Header -->
    <text x="140" y="40" class="math-title" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle" fill="#38bdf8">The Formula</text>
    <line x1="40" y1="55" x2="240" y2="55" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2"/>

    <!-- Equation Box -->
    <g transform="translate(140, 105)">
      <rect x="-110" y="-30" width="220" height="60" rx="8" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="0" y="8" class="math-title" font-size="28" text-anchor="middle" fill="#f8fafc">
        <tspan fill="#f43f5e">a</tspan><tspan font-size="18" dy="-10">2</tspan><tspan font-size="28" dy="10"> + </tspan><tspan fill="#3b82f6">b</tspan><tspan font-size="18" dy="-10">2</tspan><tspan font-size="28" dy="10"> = </tspan><tspan fill="#a855f7">c</tspan><tspan font-size="18" dy="-10">2</tspan>
      </text>
    </g>

    <!-- Key Facts / GCSE Revision Notes -->
    <g transform="translate(25, 175)" class="math-text" font-size="13">
      <!-- Bullet 1 -->
      <circle cx="10" cy="8" r="4" fill="#a855f7"/>
      <text x="25" y="12" fill="#e2e8f0"><tspan font-weight="700" fill="#a855f7">c</tspan> is ALWAYS the hypotenuse</text>
      <text x="25" y="30" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="11">(side opposite the right angle)</text>

      <!-- Bullet 2 -->
      <circle cx="10" cy="68" r="4" fill="#38bdf8"/>
      <text x="25" y="72" fill="#e2e8f0">Use to find a <tspan font-weight="700" fill="#38bdf8">missing side</tspan></text>
      <text x="25" y="90" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="11">Given the other two lengths</text>

      <!-- Bullet 3 -->
      <circle cx="10" cy="128" r="4" fill="#4ade80"/>
      <text x="25" y="132" fill="#e2e8f0">To find <tspan font-weight="700" fill="#4ade80">c</tspan>: square, add, sqrt</text>
      <text x="25" y="150" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="11">c = √(a² + b²)</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Footer Tip -->
  <g transform="translate(400, 470)">
    <text x="0" y="0" class="math-text" font-size="12" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">GCSE Mathematics Core Concept • Right-Angled Triangles</text>
  </g>

</svg>

promptText: A circle has a centre. The radius is the distance from the centre to the edge. The diameter goes across the circle through the centre and is twice the radius. The circumference is the distance around the circle.

<svg viewBox="0 0 800 500" width="100%" height="100%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <title>GCSE Physics - Series Circuit Principles</title>

  <defs>
    <!-- CSS Styles and Animations -->
    <style>
      @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@400;600;700&display=swap');
      
      .title { font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 22px; fill: #1e293b; }
      .subtitle { font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; fill: #475569; }
      .label { font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; fill: #0f172a; }
      .value { font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; fill: #2563eb; }
      .rule-title { font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; fill: #1e293b; }
      .rule-desc { font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 11px; fill: #334155; }

      /* Wire current flow animation using stroke-dashoffset */
      .current-wire {
        fill: none;
        stroke: #3b82f6;
        stroke-width: 4;
        stroke-dasharray: 8 12;
        animation: flowCurrent 1.5s linear infinite;
      }

      @keyframes flowCurrent {
        from { stroke-dashoffset: 20; }
        to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
      }

      /* Glow effect for interactive feel */
      .glow {
        filter: drop-shadow(0px 4px 8px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.15));
      }
    </style>

    <!-- Component Symbols -->
    <!-- Resistor / Lamp Symbol -->
    <g id="resistor">
      <rect x="-30" y="-15" width="60" height="30" rx="6" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="3" />
      <path d="M-20,0 L-10,-8 L0,8 L10,-8 L20,8" fill="none" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round" />
    </g>

    <!-- Cell Symbol -->
    <g id="cell">
      <line x1="-15" y1="-20" x2="-15" y2="20" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" />
      <line x1="-5" y1="-12" x2="-5" y2="12" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" />
      <line x1="5" y1="-20" x2="5" y2="20" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" />
      <line x1="15" y1="-12" x2="15" y2="12" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" />
      <text x="-18" y="-28" font-family="Poppins" font-weight="700" font-size="12" fill="#ef4444">-</text>
      <text x="12" y="-28" font-family="Poppins" font-weight="700" font-size="12" fill="#3b82f6">+</text>
    </g>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background Canvas -->
  <rect width="800" height="500" fill="#f8fafc" />

  <!-- Decorative Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="70" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="40" y="42" class="title">Series Circuit Rules</text>
  <text x="260" y="42" class="subtitle">| GCSE Physics Revision</text>

  <!-- ==================== CIRCUIT DIAGRAM SECTION ==================== -->
  <g id="circuit-section" transform="translate(40, 90)">
    
    <!-- Base Wires (Static Dark Lines) -->
    <rect x="50" y="40" width="360" height="260" rx="12" fill="none" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="4" />

    <!-- Animated Current Wires (Overlaid) -->

    <!-- COMPONENTS -->
    <!-- Cell (Bottom Wire, center x = 230, y = 300) -->

      <use href="#cell" />
      <rect x="-45" y="25" width="90" height="24" rx="4" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e2e8f0" />
      <text x="0" y="41" text-anchor="middle" class="value">6 V Cell</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Component 1: Resistor 1 (Top Wire, center x = 230, y = 40) -->

      <use href="#resistor" />
      <rect x="-45" y="-35" width="90" height="20" rx="4" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e2e8f0" />
      <text x="0" y="-21" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Resistor 1</text>
      <!-- Voltage tag -->
      <rect x="60" y="-12" width="55" height="24" rx="4" class="glow" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5" />

    <!-- Component 2: Resistor 2 (Right Wire, center x = 410, y = 170) -->

      </g>
      <rect x="35" y="-12" width="55" height="24" rx="4" class="glow" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5" />
      <text x="62" y="4" text-anchor="middle" class="value">3 V</text>
      <text x="0" y="-40" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Resistor 2</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Ammeter A1 (Left Wire, center x = 50, y = 120) -->
    <g transform="translate(50, 120)">
      <circle r="18" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="2.5" />
      <text x="0" y="6" text-anchor="middle" class="value" font-size="16">A₁</text>
      <rect x="-45" y="-30" width="90" height="18" rx="3" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e2e8f0" />
      <text x="0" y="-18" text-anchor="middle" class="label" font-size="11">0.5 A</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Ammeter A2 (Left Wire, center x = 50, y = 220) -->
    <g transform="translate(50, 220)">
      <circle r="18" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="2.5" />
      <text x="0" y="6" text-anchor="middle" class="value" font-size="16">A₂</text>
      <rect x="-45" y="16" width="90" height="18" rx="3" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e2e8f0" />
      <text x="0" y="29" text-anchor="middle" class="label" font-size="11">0.5 A</text>
    </g>

  </g>

  <!-- ==================== EXPLANATION CARDS SECTION ==================== -->
  <g id="cards-section" transform="translate(480, 90)">
    
    <!-- Card 1: Single Loop -->
    <g transform="translate(0, 0)" class="glow">
      <rect width="280" height="115" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="1.5" />
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="6" height="115" rx="3" fill="#3b82f6" />
      <text x="25" y="30" class="rule-title">1. One Single Loop</text>
      <text x="25" y="55" class="rule-desc">There are no branches or junctions.</text>
      <text x="25" y="75" class="rule-desc">Charge has only one path to flow</text>
      <text x="25" y="95" class="rule-desc">all the way around the circuit.</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Card 2: Current is the Same -->
    <g transform="translate(0, 130)" class="glow">
      <rect width="280" height="115" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="1.5" />
